text.title: PWA Advanced Features Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether a native shell already owns push, and on whether iOS Safari is the primary platform with requirements WebKit cannot serve — to the full push plus offline-queue build, a push-only iOS subset, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Does a native shell (Capacitor, Tauri, React Native) already ship this app and hold an APNs/FCM token?

conclusion.verdict: skip; push through the shell — a web subscription and a native token are independent, so every notification is delivered twice and the user disables both

branch.question: Is iOS Safari the primary platform for the users who must receive push or work offline?
Does the requirement depend on Background Sync or Periodic Background Sync, or on reaching users who will not add the app to the Home Screen (or run iOS below 16.4)?

conclusion.verdict: skip; WebKit implements neither Sync API and iOS delivers Web Push only to home-screen-installed web apps — the feature cannot be built as specified
apply the push half only: opt-in behind an explicit user gesture after install, a notification shown on every delivery, and flush the outbox on reconnect instead of Background Sync
apply in full: one server-held VAPID pair, notification on every push, 404/410 subscription pruning, idempotency-keyed outbox drained by a single stable sync tag
